name: priority
description: Evaluation order; lower runs first and the first match wins.

name: feature
description: customer_features column the condition tests, e.g. propensity_score, days_since_last_booking, loyalty_tier.

name: threshold
description: Value to compare against, stored as text (60, 0.30, gold, true). Cast to the feature's type.

name: feature_2
description: Optional second feature; when set, both conditions must hold (AND).

name: threshold_2
description: Value for the second condition, as text.

name: action
description: What to do when the rule matches: send_offer, hold_for_retargeting, route_to_loyalty_team or suppress.

name: reason_template
description: Human-readable explanation with {feature} placeholders filled from customer_features.
